types.name: Visa-free entry
types.purpose: Entering Qatar without a prior visa for visits, for eligible nationalities.
types.who: Nationals of visa-exempt countries and GCC citizens
types.note: Eligible nationalities and conditions (passport validity, hotel or onward ticket) vary; check the official list.

types.name: Visa on arrival (tourist)
types.purpose: Tourist visa issued at Qatar ports of entry to eligible nationalities.
types.note: Stay is 30 or 90 days depending on nationality; fee QAR 100 for some nationalities; some must book a Discover Qatar hotel.

types.name: Hayya Tourist Visa (A1)
types.purpose: Online tourist visa applied for in advance through the Hayya platform.
types.who: Visitors of all nationalities except GCC citizens
types.note: Hotel reservation needed on application; fee QAR 100 once approved.

types.name: Hayya GCC Resident Visa (A2)
types.purpose: Online visit visa for residents of GCC countries in authorised professions.

types.name: Hayya Visa with ETA (A3)
types.purpose: Entry visa via an Electronic Travel Authorization on the Hayya platform.

types.name: Hayya Visa for Companions of GCC Citizens (A4)
types.purpose: Entry visa for people accompanying citizens of GCC countries.

types.name: Visit visa for GCC residents
types.purpose: Visit or tourism visa issued on arrival to GCC residents in authorised professions and their companions.
types.maxValidity: 1 month, extendable to a maximum of 3 months
types.note: Residence permit and passport must be valid for at least 6 months; fee QAR 100.

types.name: Qatar-Oman Joint Tourist Visa
types.purpose: Single tourist visa covering both Qatar and Oman.
types.maxValidity: 30 days, extendable by another 30 days for a fee

types.name: Qatar Transit Visa
types.purpose: Visa for passengers transiting Hamad International Airport who are not visa-free.

types.name: Visit visa (via MOFA)
types.purpose: Visit visa for travellers to enter Qatar, obtained through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular department.
types.who: Travellers of all nationalities except GCC nationals

types.name: Family visit visa
types.purpose: Visit visa for family members of a resident, issued through the Ministry of Interior.
types.note: Newborn children can be added through Metrash.

types.name: Work visa
types.purpose: Visa requested by an employer or sponsor from the Ministry of Interior for people brought to Qatar to work.
types.who: Workers sponsored by an employer, with prior approval

types.name: Residence permit (RP)
types.purpose: Residence permit issued after entry on a residence visa, renewable for 1 to 3 years.
types.who: Expatriates sponsored for work or family
types.note: Medical check required within 30 days of entry.

types.name: Family residence
types.purpose: Residence for the spouse and family of a resident who meets the family sponsorship conditions.

types.name: Permanent residency
types.purpose: Permanent residence card under Law No. 10 of 2018 for non-Qataris meeting the conditions.
types.who: Long-term residents (e.g. 20 years of residence if born abroad)
types.note: Also requires sufficient income, a clean record and Arabic; fee QAR 3,000.
